tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text: For $\mathrm{Na}^{+}, \mathrm{Mg}^{2+}, \mathrm{F}^{-}$and $\mathrm{O}^{2-}$; the correct order of increasing Ionic radii is :

solution.text:
All species are isoelectronic $\left(10 \mathrm{e}^{-}\right)$. 
isoelectronic series, when negative charge increases the radius of ion increases.
$\therefore \mathrm{Mg}^{2+} < \mathrm{Na}^{+} < \mathrm{F}^{-} < \mathrm{O}^{2-}$
